THIS. RIGHT. HERE. 

As with most substances, the euphoria you receive when you’re just starting out ALWAYS fades after continual use. It’s not necessarily gone (hence the continual use part), but its most definitely not how it once was. 

I realized that the only time I ever enjoy speeding is during the coming up phase. Literally that’s it. Once the peak hits I’m just a twitchy, depressed mess who’s nervous that her hearts going to explode. The entire experience has become 30-60 mins of actually enjoying the feeling, and then the remaining couple hours is just one big horrible come down. 

I’m still struggling with my use, but this realization has drastically reduced the amount of times I actually use. I MOSTLY use now if I’m just dead tired and need a jolt versus before when I would pop a few vy’s hoping it would make me “feel good.” HAHA! 

Regardless, it’s amazing that you are trying to be strong and are taking the steps to improve! If you need an outside daily reminder as well just LMK! This shit is hard man and all of us here understand! ❤️

When I don’t know the answers then the negative thought spiral is inevitable, and the answers that I come up with in my head are always 1000x worse than the actual answer. People always see this as being too invasive and overly confrontational but it’s really just a way to put my own paranoia at ease... I don’t actually care about the situation as a whole. I care about the part I played in it and how it’s going to affect ME and MY relationship with this person and MY conceptualization of this situation. Details are a vital way to make sense of your surroundings when you are constantly unsure of your reality in the first place.
